scope: Public instructions only. This helper neither obtains nor inspects the account template; supplied template evidence remains semantically unverified. No field values validated. Recheck current portal rules before filing.

work identity.next_step: Reuse the existing case and work IDs. Search by at least two criteria before creation; route an existing work to a claim. Supply the composition title.

writers/publishers.next_step: Identify all known writers and roles; new registrations require at least one C or CA role. Preserve the original publisher relationship.

supported shares.next_step: Document the collection percentage for the publisher or administrator, from 0.01% to 100%. Bulk entries must cover only represented publishing shares; do not invent a split.

mandate.next_step: Link existing evidence of the represented interest, administration authority, territory and dates. Account access does not establish these facts.
mandate.basis: Local catalog authority contract; not a provider form rule

current provider form.next_step: Download the current template in Member Hub > Works Registration > Bulk Registration Tool. Keep columns in place and inspect required markers and Field Definitions. Limit each upload to 300 rows, counting writer continuation rows. A self-administered writer without publisher IPI uses individual registration.

optional_field_guidance.next_step: Bulk dependent pairs: AKA title/type, administrator name/IPI, recording title/artist. Subsequent writer rows leave A-F blank; repeat no work title.
Recording details are optional; when supplied, include recording title and artist.

remaining_account_checks: Obtain the current account template or inspect the individual form; this guidance is not a replacement upload schema.
Verify supplied values, existing provider records, account role and mandate before any separately authorized submission.
